title: Flux 2 Klein 4B text to image
description: Local text-to-image workflow using the installed Flux 2 Klein 4B FP8 model. The exact graph has produced a verified 1024x1024 PNG on the currently qualified local ComfyUI 0.37.0 worker; catalogue readiness checks required node and model filenames, not model hashes or the ComfyUI version.

values.prompt: Cinematic production still, motivated key light, controlled contrast, natural skin tones, shallow depth of field.
Clean product study on a seamless surface, soft key light, precise edges, true material texture.
Storyboard frame, clear silhouette and blocking, readable foreground and background planes, restrained colour.

evidence: Converted from image_flux2_klein_text_to_image.json in the installed comfyui-workflow-templates-json package with src/workflow/ui-to-api.ts against the live ComfyUI 0.37.0 object_info inventory. Installed source SHA-256: f5b2e75448e1ef44ab3d08da00900000f0258f8f963934370c6a1c329d1328c2. Qualified packaged API graph SHA-256 (UTF-8 with LF line endings): 5fadfac55a4abe10e6fdbf5ff83bbd94ad1152e732ffc02a6fdc385a936a10ca.

Direct local ComfyUI qualification on 2026-10-18 used the exact packaged graph, seed 20261018, 20 steps, 1024x1024. It succeeded in 18.1 seconds and produced a 1024x1024 PNG (1,944,013 bytes; SHA-256 98df53a08727d6fc8ebbc1a7f9b45ff5a734fe1393a822b2cc04d6ac0be2b4f8). This is one functional qualification, not a quality benchmark, offline guarantee, memory measurement or commercial-use authorization.
